# gyro_webhook (Resource)

A signed HTTPS webhook. The signing secret is only known at creation (kept in state, sensitive).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gyro_webhook" "ops" {
  url    = "https://hooks.example.com/gyro"
  events = ["service.active", "service.suspended", "invoice.paid"]
}

output "webhook_secret" {
  value     = gyro_webhook.ops.secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `url` (String) https:// URL on a public host.

### Optional

- `customer_id` (Number) Reseller: deliver only this end-customer's events.
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `events` (List of String) Events to send (empty = all).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) HMAC-SHA256 signing secret.
